confirmation_protocol.corpus: official full corpus, no label-dependent slice
confirmation_protocol.selection_reason: Original compact gate and r92 selected using NFCorpus development evidence. Report all targets and strong baselines; no SCIDOCS grades or outcomes inspected during preparation.
confirmation_protocol.self_match_policy: Request 101 per branch, exclude identical query/document ID before keeping 100, features and fusion.
outcome_rules: No refitting, threshold adjustment or query/corpus subsampling on SCIDOCS.
Report every fixed policy, all metrics, target misses and timing uncertainty.
Savings versus full fusion do not establish superiority over standalone retrievers.
Any target miss or failed transfer is retained in the final report; no retuning followed by a fresh-test claim.

protocol: All four original-feature Ridge gates are frozen from NFCorpus train. No refit or threshold adjustment on SCIDOCS.
Each retriever requests 101 candidates and removes the identical query/document ID before keeping 100, feature extraction, and fusion. This follows BEIR self-match exclusion.
Identical stable vectorized BM25 ranking implementation for ALL methods. Implementation previously checked against saved original NF train rankings.
Query and method order randomized in each repetition; synchronization before and after every timed query. Warmups excluded.
No cached query results or shared per-query features; fallback neural retrieval executes only on escalation. Corpus indexes may be reused.
All methods scored on identical queries/corpus. Recall/nDCG/MAP metrics use first timed repeat rankings.
Bootstrap resamples queries, pairing recall and repeat-averaged latency; intervals do not capture all hardware/session variability.
Random routing is an offline, count-matched recall reference; its latency was not measured.
First SCIDOCS frozen-policy confirmation. Outcomes and target misses are reported without retuning. RAG answer quality is not measured.
